title: AI isn't killing jobs yet: Over 50% of businesses say AI is creating roles as massive upskilling push begins
summary: The findings arrive as firms increasingly treat AI adoption as central to competitiveness, workforce skills, and long-term business growth strategy. Nearly two-thirds of larger firms say their current workforce already possesses the AI skills the business truly needs right now.
